component_type_set.description: An abstract three-element set C of positive component types.

sector_supports.description: All unordered two-element subsets of C.

content_state.description: A function n:C->N with support cardinality <=2; zero state included.

token_realization.description: A finite set U(n) partitioned by the primitive component-type map tau:U(n)->C.

admissible_relabelings.tokens: all bijections preserving declared typing, with unlabeled compatibility under S3

partial_composition.description: componentwise addition / typed disjoint union when resulting support has cardinality <=2

primitive_atomic_relations: membership of support in an unordered two-component sector
derived_not_primitive: token partition into occupied component classes
